title: Arm unveils its new C2 CPUs, Mali GPU with neural graphics, and 128-core Neoverse platform
summary: Arm launches a wave of designs for mobile and servers including high-performance CPUs, GPUs with integrated AI, and subsystems of up to 128 cores on 3 nm.

title: DLSS 5 Autopilot and Neural Rendering multiply performance on Nvidia cards and revive multi-GPU configurations
summary: The new DLSS version reduces the performance penalty and allows using a second GPU dedicated to neural rendering, achieving up to 127% more FPS.

title: Apple prepares iPhone 18 Pro with variable aperture camera and secures NAND memory supply
summary: Leaks reveal a professional camera with five new features and Apple secures NAND chips amid growing demand, though the market remains tight.

title: Mistral AI raises €3 billion in largest European tech round despite trailing rivals
summary: The French startup closes record financing to develop its own models and infrastructure, though it admits the real battle is in the application layer.

title: Industry warns that even 20 new NAND fabs wouldn't cover demand and Apple secures its chips for iPhone 18
summary: Phison and Samsung warn of a structural deficit in NAND and DRAM memory, while Apple secures supply for its next flagship.

title: TSMC builds 19 simultaneous fabs and Intel surpasses 1 million High-NA EUV wafers in race for advanced lithography capacity
summary: The two largest chipmakers aggressively expand their cutting-edge production capacity, but AI demand continues to outstrip supply.

title: Hackers steal $320 million in Bitcoin from Liquid Network and return 3,400 BTC after demanding vulnerability patch
summary: A group drains 95% of Liquid's federated wallet, calls itself 'good' and returns part of the loot after demanding the flaw be fixed.

title: Sony maintains removal of physical disc in PlayStation despite lawsuits and legal threats, but will keep manufacturing discs until 2028
summary: The company faces strong backlash and several lawsuits, but confirms new releases will lose physical format while maintaining disc production at 10% less.

title: Intel plans to raise PC CPU prices by 10% in October and discontinue low-margin models
summary: The manufacturer will raise prices on its desktop processors and stop making those that don't offer sufficient profitability.

title: Jellyfin 12.0 adds support for books and comics, faster navigation, and FFmpeg 8.1
summary: The open-source media server releases a major update focused on reading and playback performance.

title: GPT-6 Astra completes Portal autonomously in 24 hours at a cost of only $571 in tokens
summary: OpenAI's new model solves the game without human intervention, demonstrating planning and complex task execution capabilities.

title: ChatGPT Work learns user's writing style by connecting their work applications
summary: OpenAI tests a feature allowing the chatbot to mimic the user's writing based on their documents and work communications.

title: Enthusiast finds 1,920 GB of DDR4 RAM worth $12,000 in garage and keeps it
summary: An employee discovers a forgotten old server full of high-value memory and the company allows him to keep it.
